metaDescription: Free online Time Duration Calculator. Calculate the exact duration between two times.
intro: Use our free online Time Duration Calculator tool. It adds or subtracts hours and minutes based on your inputs.
whatIs: The Time Duration Calculator is an online utility that adds or subtracts hours and minutes. It processes your start time and provides total hours and minutes elapsed.
howToUse: Enter your start time into the designated input field.
Provide any secondary parameters like end time.
Click the calculate or submit button to generate total hours and minutes elapsed.
Copy or review the resulting output for your needs.
howItWorks: This tool operates in your browser by applying standard algorithms to your start time. It instantly processes the data to output total hours and minutes elapsed.
workedExample: For example: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM is 8 hours.
resultInterpretation: The result represents total hours and minutes elapsed. You can use this data for your specific calculations or formatting needs.
useCases: Quickly processing start time on the go
tipsAndLimitations: Ensure your inputs are formatted correctly for the best results.
The tool runs completely client-side, ensuring your data remains private.

faq.question: Can it cross midnight?
faq.answer: Yes, it accounts for next-day times.
